acceptance.visualAssessment: H5 knots retain their shape and are brown rather than nearly black. F4 lanes are warmer and stay visible. G5 is an excluded diagnostic, with its dust retained and lighter. H5 remains cooler and darker than the photo; the central median samples do not meet every declared numerical tolerance.
acceptance.status: The local fit improves, with visible dust retained, but does not meet every pin tolerance. The result awaits owner review; l25 remains the accepted base.

method.definition: Only H5 and F4 central 5 by 5 pixel color medians and local contrast against their 5–7 pixel square annuli enter the fit. G5 and the core ellipse have zero weight. R/G, B/G and median linear-luminance contrast are compared with the corresponding photo pixels.
method.material: kappa_lambda = 1 + q (kappa_Gordon,lambda - 1), kappa_G=1; one global strength multiplies optical depth. q is a global RGB dust appearance grade for the processed Horálek photo, not a newly measured extinction law or R_V.
method.geometry: All native clouds, diffuse fallback columns, foreground depths and adopted thicknesses are inherited exactly from l25. No clumping, smoothing, spatial optical-depth remapping or pixel transfer is introduced.
method.optimization: One bounded global strength and one bounded global selective-reddening grade; finite initial grid and two decreasing coordinate steps. No parameters per pin, pixel or region. Global lane dimming, whole-image RMS, G5 and the core do not enter the objective.
